project_identity.name: VoltCraft HDB - Singapore Electrical PM OS
project_identity.description: Enterprise-grade Singapore HDB electrical project management software for multi-block, floor-stack unit tracking, RTO approvals, Megger insulation testing, workforce, material inventory, and SGD expense management.
project_identity.design_philosophy: Tactical minimalism, field-first clarity, extreme data density for multi-block floor stacks, zero visual fluff, high-contrast status feedback for RTO inspections and insulation testing.

scale.body: text-sm sm:text-base leading-relaxed text-slate-300 dark:text-slate-300 light:text-slate-700
scale.caption: text-xs font-mono uppercase tracking-widest text-slate-400

typography.guidelines: Do NOT use Inter for main headings. Use Outfit or Cabinet Grotesk style for headings and reserve Inter/JetBrains Mono for table cells, unit numbers, megger readings, and timestamps.

colors.contrast_rules: Always maintain min 4.5:1 contrast ratio. Never use #000000 flat black; tint background with deep navy/slate (#0B0F17). Set explicit hover text colors (e.g. hover:bg-slate-800 hover:text-white). Do NOT use transparent backgrounds on headers or overlays.

floor_stack_matrix_rules.display: Matrix grid inspired by HDB physical site board charts.
floor_stack_matrix_rules.cell_style: Compact interactive badge showing stage progress (1 to 9), RTO badge, and Megger status color.

component_strategy.navigation: Sticky top bar with multi-lingual selector (EN/BN/ZH), Block quick-tabs (35A, 35B, 36A, 36B, 36C), quick search, export CSV trigger, and user role switcher (Site Engineer, RTO Inspector, Subcontractor, Manager).
shadcn_components: Dialog / Sheet (For unit details and edit workflow stage)
Tabs (For switching blocks 35A-36C and dashboard sections)
Select / DropdownMenu (For filter by stage, language, RTO status)
Table (For workforce attendance, materials, and expense entries)
Badge (For live status, megger test result PASS/FAIL)
Tooltip (For quick unit info on floor-stack matrix hover)

accessibility_and_motion.motion_library: framer-motion for tab switches, drawer side-overs, and matrix modal dialogs.
accessibility_and_motion.micro_interactions: Subtle scale-95 on button clicks, hover shadow elevation on unit matrix cells.
accessibility_and_motion.accessibility_rules: Respect prefers-reduced-motion, aria-label on all matrix badges, aria-hidden on purely decorative SVG icons, high contrast borders for focus states.

testing_attributes.rule: Every key interactive, metric, form field, modal, table row, and language option MUST have a clear data-testid attribute in kebab-case.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a fully usable, state-driven Singapore HDB Electrical PM React Web Application.
Support 3 languages: English, Bangla (বাংলা), and Chinese (中文) with an instant language switcher header dropdown.
Implement blocks 35A, 35B, 36A, 36B, 36C with realistic levels (Level 1 to 12+) and units per level (#01-450, #01-451, etc.) populated with rich editable sample data.

Provide interactive unit detail sheet/modal to advance any unit through the 9 sequential workflow steps: PVC Pipe -> Casting -> Hacking -> Wiring -> GI Box -> RTO Check -> Plastering -> Switch Fittings -> Insulation Megger Test.
Provide specific data views for workforce attendance, material inventory (PVC pipes, wires, boxes), and SGD expenses.
Add full data-testid attributes to all interactive elements, buttons, inputs, and status badges.
Do NOT use transparent header or dialog backgrounds. Ensure exact APCA accessibility contrast on dark slate background.
